projects.title: Joker: The Robotic Card Sorter
projects.description:
Why waste time sorting cards when you can get a robot to do it for you
We are building a robotic system to sort cards, using some sort of arm manipulator and computer vision.

projects.title: Keraunos
projects.description:
Watch our fully autonomous drones see red and follow anyone wearing red! Also see our coordinated drone swarm from hacked toy drones!
Hacked the toy drone remotes with Arduino, used python to stream video input of drones to perform live YOLO image detection.

projects.title: Kinect Based Fork Lift
projects.description:
Construct a fork lift controlled by kinect from scratch!
Fork lift is often clumsy to operate and difficult to control. We are trying to build an arduino based fork lift and train our kinect sensors to capture body signals and relay them back to the machine through bluetooth.

projects.title: Lanternfly Air Defense System
projects.description: Lanternflies are a pest that damage the local ecosystem and are a bother to Pittsburgh residents. We aim to create an auto-detecting pressure washer turret system to shoot and kill spotted lanternflies called Lanternfly Air Defense System (LADS). LADS will detect flying lantern flies and shoot it with a white vinegar and water mixture through a pressure washer. It will detect lanternflies using 2 cameras mounted on the turret running a machine learning detection program. When a lanternfly is detected, the turret will then turn towards the lanternfly and fire.

projects.title: Lumos
projects.tagline: For all your light and Harry Potter needs
projects.description: The Idea We wanted to make a lamp that opens up with light and flaps its wings when you touch it, much like the Golden Snitch from Harry Potter. What Actually Happened We have a lamp that lights up and resembles a Snitch! Credits Built by Team Nuts & Dolts (Jesse Chang, Madison Evans, and Katy Muhlrad) for MakeMIT 2016. <div

projects.title: MarkOff Processor
projects.description:
An autonomous robot to erase whiteboards
MarkOff Processor (MOP) is a robot that attaches to a whiteboard and autonomously erases old marks on the board. We will use neodymium magnets to attach the MOP to the whiteboard. We will have a webcam watching the whiteboard from the ground, which will send data to a computer running OpenCV. The computer will plan the movement for the MOP and send instructions to the MOP over bluetooth.

projects.title: Moball
projects.description:
We aim to create a spherical robot cabable of maneuvering around the Mobot course
We plan to start out with a passive system that will use an actuated weight to alter its path down a hill. We hope to do this using a servo as a pendulum or on a rail/linear gear in a 3D printed shell. After this, we hope to implement a path-planning system to enable the robot to traverse a course.

projects.title: Mobile Vision
projects.description:
smart automobile safety system.
Auto safety system
Platform: cell phone (android or ios)
Functions:
Using computer vision algorithm (CNN) to detect vehicle, people, stop sign, speed limit, traffic light and etc. People and vehicle information will be used in the calculation of collision warning program. Stop sign and other secondary detection can be used to update general information regarding specific road and alert other drivers.The program will also be able to send back real time traffic condition so that other drivers can avoid certain road and reach their destination faster.

projects.title: Mood Machine
projects.description:
The mood machine chooses songs, scents and lighting to match the mood of its surroundings
Mood Machine is built using an Arduino and connects to your
Android phone via Bluetooth. It picks up sound waves from its surroundings with a sound detector and analyzes the mood of the waves using NLP. Based on the input, it chooses and plays a song, creates LED lighting patterns and releases scents to match the mood. (ft taylor swift)

projects.title: Morning Coffee
projects.description:
Imagine waking up to the smell of a freshly brewed cup of coffee
Many people love to make coffee when they wake up in the morning, but how annoying is it that you have to get out of bed in the cold to make that first cup. Imagine instead if your alarm clock didn't just ring to let you know it was time to make your first cup, but if it brewed your first cup for you and you woke up to the smell of a fresh cup of coffee.

projects.title: Muscle Boyz
projects.tagline: I know that sometimes doing physio therapy can be boring or not interesting. We have come up with an idea so that we can make it more interesting.
projects.description: Inspiration How to make physio fun and engaging What it does uses a catapult to launch snacks for you pets or play basketball How we built it with arduino and myosensor Challenges we ran into Accomplishments that we're proud of What we learned What's next for Muscle Boyz <div

projects.title: My new pet kitten
projects.description:
Raising a smart kitten without worrying about spending time on them...
Have you ever dreamed of raising a cat but you hardly have time to take care of them? Do you often feel lonely and want a pet to play with you? We want to build a smart robotic cat that can play with people when they feel lonely but people do not need to worry about spending time on them or deal with troubles that real pets may cause...

projects.title: Noisy Notes
projects.description:
Quirky and fun to play (albeit a bit dissonant) touch-controlled musical instrument!
We used a ribbon controller (potentiometer), Arduino, and speaker to map the user’s finger position to a specific frequency. We also used addressable LEDs to guide the user in playing a basic song. We mounted the whole thing on wood and laser-cut acrylic and customized it to look like a frog :D

projects.title: Obstacle Avoidance Tesla
projects.tagline: Arduino/Raspberry Pi Powered Car

projects.title: Omniboard
projects.description:
An Omnidirectional Electric Skateboard
A current electric skateboard allows one dimensional motorized motion, often controlled by a handheld remote control. This limits one’s ability to control the board in crowded places such as a college campus. Our project is an omnidirectional skateboard. We plan to implement motorization in two dimensions, both forward and backward and side to side, using a swerve drive motor. The result is an evolution of the electric skateboard, which is both easy to control and extremely satisfying to ride.

projects.title: Our AutoMagic Garden
projects.description:
Garden that waters itself and manages its own lighting!
Our garden utilizes moisture sensors in the soil to know when to open its water valves and pump water into the pots. Each pot has its own water settings depending on its plant type! In additon, utilizing a light sensor, the garden knows when to turn its grow light on/off. Lastly, there is a display screen that tells the user information about the state of each potted plant.

projects.title: Robot Bartender
projects.description: We are making a robot bartender! :D This robot will have a line of dispenser spouts where alcohol bottles could be inverted and mounted onto, platform where a cup is shifted under different spouts, and will be controlled according to preprogrammed cocktail recipes.

projects.title: Rocket Shoes!
projects.description:
Tired of walking and other existing modes of transportation? Here's another one that's located in your shoes..
Ever heard of the revolutionary technology known as Heelys? We have. But we decided to take it a step further by reducing your physical exertion. That's right: motorized Heelys (aka Rocket Shoes!). We will accomplish this with teamwork, a reasonable budget, and motors.

projects.title: Rosi (Erin Hall and Rebecca Celsi, Motor Add-on)
projects.tagline: Rosi is a fully mobile robot with a smartphone mount capable of being controlled from anywhere in the world via a web server. Rosi's purpose is to help people feel more connected in video calls.

projects.title: Sonic Haptic Feedback Device
projects.description:
High-resolution, high-frequency haptic feedback using sound
I really just want to figure out what Ultrahaptics (http://spectrum.ieee.org/view-from-the-valley/consumer-electronics/gadgets/tiny-bubbles-and-force-fields-feeling-the-virtual-world-with-ultrasound) are doing and want to explore the space of using sound (ultrasonic or tactile) to generate haptic feeback.
Doing some more research into this now, will have a clearer picture when I figure out my parts

projects.title: Sound and Lights
projects.description:
Sound activated lights! Clap to make lights change color or input MIDI to make a light show
We're building lights that are activated by sound. We'll probably be using a LED matrix and a teensy/arduino for sound activation and MIDI-input. Essentially it'll be a music visualizer with colors and shaping effects

projects.title: Star Wars BB8
projects.description:
Recreating Life Size Version of BB8 Robot
We will be recreating a life size version of the Star Wars popular BB8 robot, by building a robot that can drive in any direction on top of a ball and self balancing with an IMU sensor.

projects.title: Swarm Drones to Fight Forest Fire
projects.description:
A system for forest fire prevention
We propose a system for forest fire prevention. We consider forest fire detection through sensor fusion and firebreak construction with swarm drones.

projects.title: TARTAN (Telemetry Assisted Return Through Autonomous Navigation)
projects.description:
System that can be installed in RC aircraft to allow for full autopilot & autonomous Return To Home (RTH) functionality.
Through intelligent tracking of aircraft telemetry, TARTAN will be a system that allows for any radio controlled aircraft powerful enough to carry it to support autopilot and RTH and landing functionality. This will result in much safer loss-of-signal scenarios which can be dangerous and costly with conventional RC aircraft.

projects.title: Tea Time
projects.description:
Are you tired of ordering milk tea all the time to only find it to be too sweet or lack tea flavor?
An automated milk tea machine which dispenses your custom ratio of tea, fresh milk, and sugar, with a companion iPhone app to customize your tea wirelessly. The only way to get good milk tea in Pittsburgh is to make it yourself.
Check out our code at:
https://github.com/starsword829/MTM

projects.title: The Deep Copy
projects.description:
You see it..., you want it..., you scan it..., we print it... in 3D.
The Deep Copy is essentially a 3D scanner that takes multiple snapshots of any 3D object and then creates an exact digital replica of said object. This replica can then be used to make 3D prints, enabling the user to recreate/ duplicate whatever their heart desires.

projects.title: The Quadcopter
projects.description:
An all-terrain vehicle, regardless of the terrain
This arduino-controlled quadcopter will autonomously lift a 1kg object with hooks, hover over a target, and place it down.  It will work over any terrain.

projects.title: The Real Megatron
projects.description:
Robotic wide receiver that runs preprogrammed football routes to catch a thrown pass
The robot will run a choice of pre-programmed routes so a quarterback can throw a football into a net that is attached to it.  When the ball is thrown, the bot will use computer vision to adjust it's route in order to catch the ball.

projects.title: Thrust Vectoring Rocket
projects.description:
Fins: Gone. We're taking model rocketry to another galaxy
We are building a finless model rocket controlled by servos with a control feedback loop instead of aerodynamic stabilization. Utilizing servos, 3d printing, an Arduino, and a gyroscope we are taking off the fins and going rogue. See you in the skies.

projects.title: Treehacks signifeye app
projects.tagline: Project developed for TreeHacks
projects.description: Signifeye Signifeye aims to create convenience for patients with visual disabilities, one sense at a time. Code entails hardware coding for the Arduino boards along with an accomodating React Native application that can be used by both the patients and patient assistants with haptic feedback manipulation. Developed as part of the TreeHacks 2023. Image 1. The app itself entails a remote control and dashboard for patient tracking, with the remote control side of the app focusing more on haptic feedback for the patient. Image 2. The mockup of the actual hardware that uses ultrasonic sensors on the glasses that the patient would be wearing. The sensors are coded to different auditory tones that the patient would hear.

projects.title: V.O.I.D - Virtual Operated Intelligent Dorm
projects.description:
You won't even realize it's there ...
Do you struggle with juggling schoolwork, activities, and life with newfound home chores like cooking and cleaning? Have you ever been locked out of your own dorm without your phone or card? Well look no further. The CS/ECE team at Rez has tackled this problem by upgrading their room to complement their lifestyles while having a fun time learning about and working with AI, Computer Vision, sensors, and more! We emailed the plan for Track 2!

projects.title: VR Game
projects.description:
Make your VR experience even more real!
Interact with both physical objects and virtual environments for a fuller VR experience. We plan to integrate the virtual environment through hardware interfaces, which include Arduinos, sensors, and many more.

projects.title: Wake 'n' Shake
projects.description: Many people feel tired in the morning, and today’s alarm clocks are too forgiving about letting people sleep in. Our new and improved alarm clock fixes this issue by making snoozing a challenge, requiring the user to get out of bed and complete a customizable task for the device to turn off. Not only does this motivate users to get up, but it also provides a healthy, daily dose of mental and physical stimulation that everyone could benefit from!

projects.title: Wall-d
projects.description:
Wall-e, just an earlier version.
Wall-e, just an earlier version. Also, he doesn't compact trash. Yet.
The plan:
A miniature replica of Wall-e that can roll around and move his arms/eyes. Most of the machinery will be contained within his body, hence the inability to compact trash.
We plan to make Wall-d capable of object detection so that he can be expressive in his human-robot and plant-robot interactions.

projects.title: Wheel Heater
projects.description:
Develop an automatic wheel heater for cast elastomer polyurethane wheels
Automatic wheel heater for cast elastomer polyurethane. Continuous rotation servos connected to Arduinos to automatically spin the wheels at variable speeds. And a web interface to read the outputs from the Arduino and display and control the temperature of each wheel.

projects.title: Wireless Luggage Follower
projects.description:
The luggage is wirelessly connected to a user's phone, and follows the user without the need to push it
This project is aimed at making travel experience much more convenient for people with physical impairment. We want to make it much more energy efficient rather than just using bluetooth connection.
We want to make the device as an extension that users can purchase, rather than a specific luggage brand. This puts the quality of luggage on existing brands, while we focus on the quality, strength and durability of the extension.

projects.title: Zeus
projects.description:
2-in-1 projector and camera that extends your desktop with interactive hand gestures to read and write documents.

projects.title: PrintPal  打印伙伴
projects.tagline: 链接情绪交流的智慧打印机
projects.description:
“亲爱的xx,
见字如唔，今天是我们相识的第二周
仍然记得你在PrintPal  为我传递的那份饱含诗意的简讯，
我相信在过度信息化的AI时代中很少有因文笔而一见如故的友谊，
纸短情长，而我读懂了你。”

在浮躁与喧嚣的AI世界中，以纸质信息传递情感是错开时代高峰的别致浪漫；
我们不做传统意义上的dating app或通信工具，而是以AI社区做链接，以纸质信息传递人与人之间的心意与温暖；


“小P，早上好，今天计划先去用户调研，然后写报告......”
“ToDoList：......”
“小P，我要背单词了，你帮我打印十个雅思词汇给到我......”
“单词如下：......”
“小P，好无聊啊，你给我讲个故事好不好啊......”
“很久以前......”

在高度数字化的时代洪流中，逆流而上，以纸质信息重塑交互流程；
我们不做千篇一律的移动端小工具，而是以纸条做载体，在物理世界中留下真实的痕迹

projects.title: 星云航线
projects.tagline: 《星云航线》是一款融合星环飞行、三角色协作与生态重建的轻科幻游戏，玩家与多吉、小咪、帕丁一起帮助机器人拾光修好放映机，让无法登上屋顶的阿栖看见约定中的流星雨，并在后续副本中通过小游戏收集生态火种，逐步恢复地球家园。
projects.description:
《星云航线》是一款融合星环飞行、角色协作、互动叙事、小游戏挑战与生态重建的单人轻科幻休闲游戏。玩家驾驶龟壳号，与多吉、小咪、帕丁和园丁机器人拾光一起穿越星球轨道，收集维修零件、调度留影分身，完成修复任务。项目以“主线修复放映机，副本重建地球”为整体结构，让连续飞行、短时冲刺、独立小游戏和建设反馈形成相互衔接的游玩体验。

故事从一个晚上八点的约定开始。阿栖因轮轴生锈，无法登上温室屋顶观看流星，拾光便用自己的备用电池换来一台报废的流星放映机，希望将星空送到朋友身边。三位伙伴决定帮助他寻找六件修复部件。旅途中，半截钥匙、紫玻璃片、缺齿八音盒、天台地图和未寄出的邀请函，逐步揭开拾光与阿栖共同生活的往事，也让玩家理解这趟旅程为什么值得坚持。最终，伙伴们不仅修好设备，还重新调整光路，让流星映入阿栖的一楼窗玻璃，兑现约定。

主线采用持续前进的星环飞行玩法。玩家根据零件颜色和所在轨道切换角色，安排主船与两艘留影分身协作接取，同时躲避红刺雷、维持护盾并积累能量，适时释放星灯脉冲清障。留影以维修伴航器的形式融入科幻世界，使角色分工与玩家操作对应起来。游戏兼顾即时反应与提前布阵，随着轨道增加，逐步引导玩家从单船接件转向三船协作。

多吉、小咪、帕丁分别对应绿色机械、紫色信号与蓝色光学零件，也承担不同的故事作用。多吉负责让设备重新运转，学习从独自承担转向信任伙伴；小咪负责信号与节拍，在准确记录之外理解

projects.title: 超越机器人（续）
projects.tagline: 竖屏互动影游。宇航员困在深空，每打一通，地球时间就快三倍。玩家陪他打七通电话，每通一轮：私聊、遥控机器人替身陪奶奶、写即兴卡让AI实时接戏并生成视频、从画面找破绽验收托付。宇航员熬3年，地球过了300年。
projects.description:
《超越机器人（续）》是一部竖屏互动影游，讲一个人和他的机器人替身之间，跨越 300 年的七通电话。它是送给一对双胞胎朋友的生日礼物：高越和机器人 SGT3000 分别按兄弟俩高越、高超的样子来做，故事接着他们原来那部片子往下讲，所以叫"续"。

**故事**

宇航员高越出发去天鹰座之前，买了一个和自己长得一模一样的机器人 SGT3000，让它替自己陪着青岛的奶奶。第一通电话还是嬉皮笑脸的日常，之后星舰坠入天鹰暗裂，这里每隔半年发生一次星震，只有星震平息的几分钟里信号才能打出去。更要命的是，每震一次，地球那边的时间就快三倍。高越以为只过了半年，家里已经过了 10 个月；他熬了 3 年，地球过了 303 年。

七通电话，奶奶的白发、病号服、墓碑一点点出现在画面里。SGT3000 不能说谎，它只会沉默、绕开，或者转述奶奶的原话，真相要玩家自己找。

**玩法：每通电话五个环节**

1. 看双环钟：外圈是星舰时，每通永远转一圈；内圈是地球时，每通比上一通快三倍，从 1 圈到 405 圈，最后糊成一道实心光环。
2. 视频私聊：和 SGT3000 交换近况，推动剧情。
3. 远程遥控：切到 SGT3000 的第一视角，替奶奶实现心愿卡，再出一张即兴卡捉弄机器人。
4. 验收托付：检查上一通托付的事办得怎么样，在画面里点出破绽，线索收进疑点本。
5. 留下托付：留一张托付卡，下一通验收。
